test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1172f99755dc0b3c894ddf8a93f94aa44f203666f6aa8575abfc0fac93d55c2c.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Middle figure is rotated in a 90º anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cb638f5a8428f31a5d4b90b3b4847a7595d07ff3f3d716b6da1a45fc69e4577.png] 

2) Addition of + 1 and shifted right-hand side and same letter shifted toward the left-hand side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08d94d8d02e7abd9c53301a8221fa9e27657ebedf2778a06b6ac841136e3c4a5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
